questions.prompt: What are the two most common remote image servers in LXD?
questions.explanation: ubuntu: hosts official Ubuntu images. images: hosts community images for many Linux distributions.

questions.prompt: How do you list images available on the ubuntu: remote?
questions.explanation: lxc image list <remote>: lists images available on that remote server.

questions.prompt: What happens when you launch an instance from a remote image for the first time?
options: LXD downloads the image and caches it locally
LXD creates the instance directly on the remote server
LXD refuses — you must download the image first
LXD creates a minimal instance without the image
questions.answer: LXD downloads the image and caches it locally
questions.explanation: LXD downloads the image from the remote server and caches it. Subsequent launches from the same image use the cached copy.

questions.prompt: How do you reference an Ubuntu 24.04 image from the ubuntu: remote?
questions.explanation: Remote images are referenced as <remote>:<image>, e.g. ubuntu:24.04
